verdict.rationale: Pilot is an accounting and bookkeeping service, where user-defined automation rules are a fair question, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no user-configurable rule or trigger capability. 'Custom workflows' on the pricing page is unspecified and never described as user-defined event triggers. The automatic transaction classification and Gusto credit application are done by Pilot or a partner, not rules the user defines.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
